items.html: And behold, although we have said that the three letters Hey-Vav-Hey are NRN, they are so only in the aspect of NRN for the Nukva of ZA herself, which is in Atzilut. But in the aspect of BYA, we have already explained above that those thirty Sefirot of the Nukva of Atzilut are divided within them and become a real aspect of Neshama for them. And from here onward — that is, from the aspect of the Neshama that is in BYA and onward — they are not the aspect of Elohut, but only in the secret of "and from there it separated and became four heads" (u-misham yipared ve-haya le-arba'a rashim), and it is called separation (Pirud). That is to say, there is also an aspect of Ruach in BYA, and an aspect of Nefesh, and also in the aspect of the garments, as will be stated, with God's help. Hence the parts of the Neshama that are in BYA are Elohut; but from the aspect of Ruach and onward is the aspect of the world of separation, whether in Beria, whether in Yetzira, or whether in Assiya.
